# API keys

The scripts read keys from a plain-text file at the repository root. Create `api_key.md`
with the following contents (this file is intentionally NOT included in the release):

```
OPENAI_KEY=sk-...
CLAUDE_KEY=sk-ant-...
GEMINI_KEY=...
GROK_KEY=xai-...
MISTRAL_KEY=...
```

The Kimi judge runs through QUBRID's OpenAI-compatible endpoint
(`https://platform.qubrid.com/v1`) and reads its key from the same file.
